body:
I think that getting this on demand means that anything that calls `GodotJavaWrapper::get_activity()` will need to remember to `env->DeleteLocalRef(activity)` when it's done?

This may also create some issues with `DisplayServerAndroid::window_get_native_handle(WINDOW_HANDLE)` which will return a `jobject` that may not be valid after it's been returned
